svg.title: Tlachihuani 1.0.0 — System Architecture and Security Boundaries
svg.desc: Layered architecture of Tlachihuani 1.0.0: outgoing HTTPS link to xaiht.org with zero open ports, unelevated Windows User Session (XT System Tray, Local Browser and Tlamatini Panels, Flow Pills Window), three Session 0 virtual-account Windows services (Tlachihuani, Tlachihuani.Jobs on 127.0.0.1:12064, Tlachihuani.RemoteController on 127.0.0.1:12481), Installed Tlamatini (English and Spanish), plus unified trace logging, native Control CLI, and isolated ProgramData state.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: EXTERNAL NETWORK · ANY ROUTER, OFFICE FIREWALL OR HOTSPOT · OUTGOING HTTPS ONLY
Zero Inbound Ports · Explicit Account Approval
Authenticated HTTPS relay (website sees plaintext · not E2EE / PQ)
Services & RC panels · Interactive launch broker
Outgoing xaiht.org link · Copyable error reports
Live EN / ES mobile PWA · 12-column customizable queue
Separate per-user process · Never runs on open
Draws & runs .flw agentic flows & .fpmt prompt pills
Up to 256 concurrent runs · RAM-aware · Reply bar
▲ 25s Outgoing HTTPS Long Poll · DPAPI Key · Zero Open Ports
SESSION 0 · OWN-PROCESS VIRTUAL ACCOUNTS · MANUAL STARTUP (STOPPED AFTER REBOOT)
Closed typed operations · Global mutex · Verified handles
Atomic SHA-256 Downloads\Torrenter · Retained on uninstall
Tlachihuani 1.0.0 · Created by Angela López Mendoza · XAIHT
